answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
